name: Pornography And Marriage
overview: Scripture clearly condemns lustful desires as equivalent to adultery in the heart, emphasizing the defilement that comes from sinful thoughts and actions such as fornication and uncleanness. Marriage is honored by God as a sacred union, where husbands are called to love their wives deeply and protect the sanctity of the marriage bed. Believers are urged to mortify earthly passions and idolatrous desires, recognizing that God will judge those who engage in sexual immorality, including adultery and whoredom. Thus, pornography stands in direct opposition to the biblical call to purity, love, and faithfulness within marriage.
